title: Setup & Maintenance
question: Want your books set up and kept on track?
description: Build a bookkeeping system that stays organized as your business grows. I’ll set up your accounts, connect your financial feeds, and maintain accurate records so your books stay on track.

title: Cleanup Bookkeeping
question: Are your books messy or inaccurate?
description: If your books are messy, inconsistent, or overdue for attention, I’ll get them back in order. From transaction corrections to account reconciliations, I’ll clean up the details and leave you with reliable financial records.

title: Catch-Up Bookkeeping
question: Are your books behind?
description: Fell behind on your bookkeeping? I’ll work through your missing transactions, reconcile your accounts, and bring your records current so you can get back to running your business with accurate numbers.

title: Ongoing Bookkeeping
question: Need accurate financial reports?
description: Keep your books accurate month after month without having to do it yourself. I’ll handle transaction categorization, account reconciliations, and financial record maintenance so you always have dependable numbers to work with.
